title: Code Organization
description: Structure your codebase for maintainability and discoverability.

data.text: **Clean code organization** makes it easy to find and understand code. Group related functionality together and follow consistent project structure conventions.

items: Follow the principle of least astonishment

data.title: Project Structure
data.content:
MyApp/
├── src/
│   ├── MyApp.Domain/          # Entities, value objects
│   ├── MyApp.Application/     # Use cases, DTOs
│   ├── MyApp.Infrastructure/  # Data access, external services
│   └── MyApp.API/             # Controllers, middleware
├── tests/
│   ├── MyApp.Domain.Tests/
│   ├── MyApp.Application.Tests/
│   └── MyApp.API.Tests/
└── MyApp.sln

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Organize by feature or by layer
Use consistent naming for files and folders
data.takeaway: A well-organized codebase helps developers find and understand code quickly.
